summary: Short kerb beside Lusso Residences apartments at a junction; steep and no stopping.

best_section.where: Prospect Terrace kerb under Lusso Residences, near the junction

drivers.seclusion: Apartment block (Lusso Residences) 7m from the kerb along the whole stretch, with a shop at 3m. Houses across the road 15-23m.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a few cars parked at the kerb, but it sits right at a junction.
drivers.traffic: Busy corner by a main road; through traffic and turning cars.
drivers.convention: Signed No Stopping Any Time at the kerb.

sun_shade: Building shades the kerb from the north in the morning and midday; open to the west afternoon.
